links.outcome: Inexperienced neurologists' DWI-FLAIR mismatch accuracy and AUC-ROC without vs with model output, lesions ≥15 mL
links.effect: In the subgroup with lesion volume ≥15 mL, accuracy improved from 0.537 to 0.610 and AUC-ROC from 0.493 to 0.613 with the model's results.
links.quote: In the subgroup with 15  mL or greater lesion volume, the evaluation of DWI-FLAIR mismatch from NCCT by inexperienced neurologists improved in accuracy (from 0.537 to 0.610) and AUC-ROC (from 0.493 to 0.613).

screen.reason: The study conducted a reader study evaluating whether inexperienced neurologists' diagnostic accuracy for DWI-FLAIR mismatch on NCCT improved with versus without AI assistance.
